evidence.summary: The brand's own Affiliate Program Terms & Requirements (last updated September 2026), section 8 'Commission Structure & Tracking': 'No Commission Cap: There is no limit to the total amount of commission you can earn.' — an explicit no-limit earnings statement in the brand's own program terms, so commission_cap is uncapped. The same section sets a milestone bonus of '$100 in SGS Rewards' at $1,000 in total referred sales — that bonus is paid in store credit; the commission itself is paid out in money (payouts issued by check once the approved balance reaches $100).

The brand's own pages conflict on the rate: the Terms (section 8) set 10% commission on first-time purchases and 5% recurring commission on repeat purchases, while the brand's own affiliate landing page advertises '15% commission on every sale' (first orders and repeat purchases alike), a $25 first approved video payment and a '+$100 Cash Bonus at $1,000 in Sales' (the Terms describe that $100 as SGS Rewards credit). Because the brand's own two pages conflict, commission_rate is null. The Terms state the program 'is designed for sports coaches, trainers, athletes, sports influencers, fitness and athletic content creators, club organizers, team managers, and sports organizations', require 1-2 posts per month to stay active, and publish the Affiliate Relations contact sales@sportsgearswagpromo.com.
